first_in_archive: This Could Be The Last Time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Last Time** (1 review, 1 other source): The Last Time was played for the first time by this band, dedicated to Charlie Watts, who died the day before; Uploader says the song was a first for Dead & Company, dedicated to Charlie Watts, who died 2021-08-24 [1][5]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Opening Viola Lee Blues suggested a rocker to this attendee, but the set never really took off [6]
- **Space** (1 review): Around three minutes into Space, the band plays a bit of Tears for Fears' 'Listen' [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ship Of Fools**: back after 32 archived shows (797 days) [8]
- **Loose Lucy**: back after 27 archived shows (788 days) [8]
- **This Could Be The Last Time**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]

## The recordings

- **deadco2021-08-25.DarienParkDarienLakeNY** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **deadco2021-08-25.153143.nak700.jtny.fix.sbefail.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 185 min [2]
- **dac2021-08-25.AKGmix.toaste.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **dac2021-08-25.AKGmultitrack.toaste.flac16**: source not stated; 6 songs; 1123 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the recording is of the Darien Lake show in Darien Center, NY, and Charlie Watts died 2021-08-24 [5]
- Attendee thought the show lacked energy and Bobby and John seemed annoyed with each other on stage [6]
- Oteil played drums during Drums, and Space included Billy and Mickey [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2021-08-25.DarienParkDarienLakeNY**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Nakamichi CM700's w 701 Caps > GakCables > Lunatec V3 > Sound Devices 722 @ 24/96 [1]
- **deadco2021-08-25.153143.nak700.jtny.fix.sbefail.flac16**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Nakamichi CM700's w 701 Caps > GakCables > Lunatec V3 > Sound Devices 722 @ 24/96 [2]. Also: Recorded by JT/NY using Nakamichi CM700s, Lunatec V3 and Sound Devices 722 at 24/96, then edited and converted to FLAC [2]
- **dac2021-08-25.AKGmix.toaste.flac16**: taped by Toaste; transferred by Toaste; source: 1x AKG393 Hypercardioid (C); 1x AKG394 Figure-8 (L,R); 2x AKG391 cardioids DIN (L,R); 2x AKG398 shotguns pointed at stacks (L,R) > Zoom F8 @ 44.1/16 [3]. Also: Taped from section 400, row 1, seat 8, using AKG 393, 394, 391 and 398 mics into a Zoom F8 at 44.1/16 [3]
- **dac2021-08-25.AKGmultitrack.toaste.flac16**: taped by Toaste; transferred by Toaste; source: 1x AKG393 Hypercardioid (C); 1x AKG394 Figure-8 (L,R); 2x AKG391 cardioids DIN (L,R); 2x AKG398 shotguns pointed at stacks (L,R) > Zoom F8 @ 44.1/16 [4]. Also: Unmixed single-mic tracks from AKG 393, 394, 391 and 398 microphones into a Zoom F8 at 44.1/16; needs mixing [4]
